description: Keep a strategy from the studio library as the trader's own script, its rules exactly as published, so it can be filmed, rehearsed or sent to the gate under its own name. The only change allowed is the glyph each of its states wears on the chart and in a film. Use this, never forge, when the trader names a library strategy: the forge cannot read the library and would write a different rule. Returns the kept name (pass it to film as scripts) and the glyphs it changed.

glyphs.description: optional: a glyph per state name (as the script names its states), each one of ◇ ◈ ▣ ■ □ ▲ ▼ ● ○

name: library_keep
